line: A pop-up book opening page by page: layered card, fold lines, paper cities rising under a lamp.
line_cn: 一页页打开的立体书：层叠卡纸、折痕、台灯下升起的纸城。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Everything is cut card: layered flat shapes with visible edges, fold lines and tabs.
Scenes rise as a page opens and fold flat as it closes.
A real desk lamp lights the book; paper casts soft shadows on paper.
Characters are paper puppets on tabs, moving in slides and flips.
not: Not flat 2D: the layers have real depth and shadow.
Not origami: cut and glued card, not folded sculpture.
Not CGI paper: edges are fibrous, glue is visible.
materials: Coloured card with visible fibre at the cut edge; printed textures on the card.
Fold lines, tabs, a central gutter; a book on a wooden desk.
Lamp light from one side; soft paper shadows.

rules: Each page has its own card palette of four or five colours.
The book's ground is cream card; the desk is dark wood.
One accent character or object in a colour no other card uses.

type.titleFont: a storybook serif, printed on the page
type.subtitleFont: a serif, cream on dark card
type.placement: titles on the book's cover or a page corner; captions bottom
rules: Words are assembler captions; the page's printed text must be illegible decoration or absent.
Pages open and close at a reader's pace; the scene rises with the page.
Puppets slide along slots and flip; nothing walks naturally.
The camera is the reader's eye: slow, close, over the gutter.

grammar.note: over the gutter as the page opens
into one layer of the page
the page held while puppets move
to the whole open book on the desk

framing: Low over the page so layers stack; the gutter line visible in wides.
Puppets at least a third of frame height on emotional beats.

foley: a puppet sliding in a slot
sound.ambience: a quiet room at night, a lamp hum, rain outside
sound.silence: the page half-open; everything holds; the next fold lands alone
sound.voice: a bedtime storyteller, close and warm
sound.musicDefault: music box and celesta, gentle, storybook

nativeMoves.name: The page opens
nativeMoves.what: A whole scene rises from flat card.
nativeMoves.build: bridge link: anchor last frame (closed page) → end frame (open scene); tilt move.

nativeMoves.name: Layer parallax
nativeMoves.what: Card layers slide against each other as the eye moves.
nativeMoves.build: truck move, moderate amplitude, beats name the layers.

nativeMoves.name: The flip puppet
nativeMoves.what: A character flips to show another state.
nativeMoves.build: jump_cut with 'the paper puppet flips to its other side: now…'.

nativeMoves.name: Close the book
nativeMoves.what: The scene folds flat and the cover closes.
nativeMoves.build: pull_out to the desk; last shot; assembler fade to black.

pitfalls.fix: Say 'cut card with fibrous edges, visible glue tabs, lamp light' in the suffix.
Describe 'paper puppets sliding on tabs, flipping'.

pitfalls.problem: The book disappears into a full 3D world.
pitfalls.fix: Keep 'the gutter and the desk visible' in wides; return with a pull_out.

look.genre: paper pop-up storybook film, handmade, warm bedtime tone
look.palette: coloured card, cream pages, dark wooden desk, one accent puppet colour
look.camera: the reader's eye low over the page, tilts as pages open, slow trucks for parallax
look.lens: macro to normal, shallow focus on card layers
look.lighting: a single warm desk lamp from one side, soft paper shadows

engine.beatSuffix: A paper pop-up book of layered cut card under a desk lamp, fold lines and tabs visible.

structures: five pages, five places, one traveller
one page opened three times, each time changed
a story told from the back of the book forward
openings: the closed book on the desk, the lamp switched on
a page already open, the puppet asleep
a hand-free pull of the first tab
endings: the last page left open and the lamp off
the pull-out to a shelf of books
